name: PokeAPI
tagline: Free RESTful Pokémon data API for species, moves, abilities, and more
description: PokeAPI is a free, open-source RESTful API that provides comprehensive Pokémon data including species, moves, abilities, types, games, and evolution chains. No authentication is required. Widely used in hobby projects, games, and educational apps. Note: this is the general Pokémon data API at pokeapi.co, not the separate Pokémon TCG card API.

auth.details: No authentication required. Fully public API with no API keys or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Completely free; no hard rate limits on REST (static hosting since Nov 2018). Fair-use: cache locally; IP bans for abuse.

rate_limits: No rate limits on REST API (removed Nov 2018). Fair-use caching expected; abuse may result in IP bans. GraphQL mirror (graphql.pokeapi.co): 100 calls/hour per IP.
use_cases: look up a Pokémon species by name or national dex ID
list moves, abilities, and type effectiveness for a Pokémon
fetch evolution chain data for a species
get sprite and artwork URLs for a Pokémon
browse Pokémon by generation, type, or egg group
build a Pokédex UI with paginated resource lists
